تغرندوا (form IIIq)
# تَغْرَنْدُوا (taḡrandū) /taɣ.ran.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# تُغْرَنْدَوْا (tuḡrandaw) /tuɣ.ran.daw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
